pins.head: A SECOND ROD, NO TOOLS
pins.title: Small Closet Organization: Hang a Second Rod Under the First
pins.desc: Small closet organization usually starts with the dead air under the hanging clothes. A short second rod that hooks onto the first turns one row into two for everything that does not need full length, slim hangers keep the row from bunching, and clear boxes on the floor keep shoes visible. A hanging shelf organizer at one end takes the folded things. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #RenterFriendly #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A narrow reach-in closet with knit sweaters hanging from the upper rod and shirts on a short second rod clamped below it, clear lidded shoe boxes stacked on the floor and a grey fabric hanging shelf organizer of rolled scarves at the right.

pins.head: CANISTERS BEAT BOXES
pins.sub: A Shelf You Can See Into
pins.title: Renter Friendly Storage: A Small Pantry Set Up Without Tools
pins.desc: Renter friendly storage in a shallow pantry is mostly about seeing what you already own. Decant dry goods into matching clear canisters so a half bag of rice stops hiding behind a tall box, keep loose produce in two open baskets on the middle shelf, and leave the lowest shelf for stacking bins you can pull out whole. Nothing here is fixed to a wall. Contains affiliate links. #PantryOrganization #RenterFriendly #SmallKitchen
pins.alt: An open narrow pantry cupboard with pale wooden shelves: a row of clear canisters of pasta, rice, oats and beans on the upper shelf, woven baskets of onions and potatoes below them, and clear stacking bins of nuts and dried fruit on the lowest shelf.

pins.head: MICA, PASTE OR INK
pins.sub: Three Ways to Color a Pour
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Tips: Mica Powder, Pigment Paste or Alcohol Ink
pins.desc: One of the epoxy resin tips that saves the most waste is matching the colorant to the look you want. Mica powder gives a pearly shimmer and stays suspended, pigment paste reads solid and opaque, and alcohol ink spreads into translucent veins. Start with a pinch, stir, and judge the color in the cup before you pour. Contains affiliate links. #ResinColor #MicaPowder #ResinCrafts
pins.alt: Three small open glass jars of loose mica powder in rose, pale gold and deep plum standing in a row on a dark walnut board, with a steel spoon of rose powder in front and a clear cup of uncolored resin behind.

pins.head: POUR THE WHOLE SET AT ONCE
pins.sub: One Batch, One Set of Coasters
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: Pour a Coaster Set in One Batch
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners goes smoother when the first project is one small set rather than one piece at a time. Mix enough for every mold you plan to fill, pour them in the same sitting, and they all cure together with the same color and the same finish. Half-batches a day apart almost never match. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #ResinCoasters #BeginnerCrafts
pins.alt: Three round resin coasters with a teal, cream and gold swirl resting on a pale linen cloth on a light oak table, with an empty dusty pink round silicone mold behind them.

pins.head: PEEL IT BACK, NOT UP
pins.title: Cricut Vinyl Tips: Pull Transfer Tape Back at a Low Angle
pins.desc: The cricut vinyl tips that fix most lifted corners come down to the angle. Pull the transfer tape back flat against itself rather than straight up, go slowly from one corner, and the decal stays on the surface instead of coming with the film. If a piece starts to lift, press it down and carry on from the other side. Contains affiliate links. #CricutProjects #TransferTape #VinylCrafts
pins.alt: A sheet of clear gridded transfer tape lifted at one corner off a navy leaf decal that has settled onto a white ceramic tile on a pale maple desk, with a cream squeegee and a navy vinyl offcut nearby.

pins.head: SHEETS, NOT A BIG ROLL
pins.title: Vinyl Sheets for Cricut Projects: Matte Colors by the Pack
pins.desc: Vinyl sheets suit small cutting projects better than one long roll: a square sheet lies flat on the mat with no curl to fight, and an assorted pack means you are not buying a whole roll of a color you will use once. Matte permanent film is the forgiving choice for mugs, tumblers and labels. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutProjects #CraftSupplies
pins.alt: A fanned stack of square matte adhesive vinyl sheets in sage, mustard, rust, dusty blue and cream on a light wood workbench, the top sheet with its white paper backing peeled back at one corner, beside a wooden-handled weeding hook.
